Titanfall on mobile? The fuck?

This will go one of two ways. Either they try to port the actual game to mobile, and fail miserably because of touch controls, or they will take a tried and true mobile format, such as freemium time based games, or tower defense or something, and skin it with Titanfall, maybe with some bonuses you can unlock in the real game. I wouldn't be happy about either tbh.

Me neither, but of the two approaches I'd think the second one is more reasonable. I'd be up for a well-designed and thoughtful mobile game that expands the Titanfall universe, but I don't think they could make it a shooter by any means, unless they have something industry-changing up their sleeves. I certainly hope it doesn't turn into a tacked on companion game just designed to rake in more money. I do think that Titanfall has a lot of potential to flesh out lore in their universe, since it's an interesting world that was only touched on in the first game, and a mobile game would be a relatively economic way to do that in between games. But if they end up doing one of the two approaches you've outlined, I can't imagine it will be well received.
